tell.text: A black star promo symbol and a "DP" number at the bottom right

description.text: The German print of Tropical Wind, DP Black Star Promo DP05, the promo card of the 2007 Pokémon World Championships, which competitors received in seven languages, German among them. It has the Worlds 07 stamp on its picture.

tell.text: A World Championships stamp on the picture: "Worlds" and the year on early cards, the World Championships logo and year on later ones.

description.text: The German print of Buneary, DP Black Star Promo DP06. The English card: a holofoil Buneary sold at Target from September 2007 in a Mysterious Treasures two-pack blister with one Mysterious Treasures and one POP Series 3 booster pack; the same blister came with Cranidos DP07 instead. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Cranidos, DP Black Star Promo DP07. The English card: a holofoil Cranidos sold at Target from September 2007 in two Mysterious Treasures blisters: a two-pack with one Mysterious Treasures and one POP Series 3 booster pack, which also came with Buneary DP06, and a three-pack with two Mysterious Treasures packs and one EX series pack, which also came with Shieldon DP08. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Shieldon, DP Black Star Promo DP08. The English card: a holofoil Shieldon sold at Target from September 2007 in a Mysterious Treasures three-pack blister with two Mysterious Treasures booster packs, one EX series pack and a Shieldon coin. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Torterra LV.X, DP Black Star Promo DP09. The English card: one of three Diamond & Pearl Collector's Tins released in September 2007, each with four Diamond & Pearl series booster packs and a holofoil LV.X of a Sinnoh starter's final form: Torterra LV.X here, Infernape LV.X DP10 and Empoleon LV.X DP11. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Infernape LV.X, DP Black Star Promo DP10. The English card: one of three Diamond & Pearl Collector's Tins released in September 2007, each with four Diamond & Pearl series booster packs and a holofoil LV.X of a Sinnoh starter's final form: Infernape LV.X here, Torterra LV.X DP09 and Empoleon LV.X DP11. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Empoleon LV.X, DP Black Star Promo DP11. The English card: one of three Diamond & Pearl Collector's Tins released in September 2007, each with four Diamond & Pearl series booster packs and a holofoil LV.X of a Sinnoh starter's final form: Empoleon LV.X here, Torterra LV.X DP09 and Infernape LV.X DP10. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Lucario LV.X, DP Black Star Promo DP12. The English card: the holofoil Lucario LV.X from the Lucario tin, released in November 2007 at stores such as Target and Toys R Us with three Secret Wonders booster packs and one Mysterious Treasures pack. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Buizel, DP Black Star Promo DP13. The English card: a holofoil Buizel sold from November 2007 at stores such as Target and Wal-Mart in a blister with a holofoil reprint of POP Series 6 Gible. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Chatot, DP Black Star Promo DP14. The English card: a holofoil Chatot sold from November 2007 at stores such as Target and Wal-Mart in a blister with a holofoil reprint of POP Series 6 Pikachu, one Mysterious Treasures and three Secret Wonders booster packs, and a blue or red Energy coin. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Shinx, DP Black Star Promo DP15. The English card: a holofoil Shinx from the Diamond & Pearl Trainer's Challenge Set, in stores by the end of September 2007. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Pikachu, DP Black Star Promo DP16. The English card: a holofoil Pikachu found from November 2007 at Wal-Mart in a blister with a Secret Wonders theme deck and a Mysterious Treasures booster pack. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Dialga LV.X, DP Black Star Promo DP17. The English card: one of three LV.X tins released at the end of February 2008, each with four booster packs (one Great Encounters, one Mysterious Treasures and two Secret Wonders) and a holofoil LV.X: Dialga LV.X here, Palkia LV.X DP18 or Darkrai LV.X DP19. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Palkia LV.X, DP Black Star Promo DP18. The English card: one of three LV.X tins released at the end of February 2008, each with four booster packs (one Great Encounters, one Mysterious Treasures and two Secret Wonders) and a holofoil LV.X: Palkia LV.X here, Dialga LV.X DP17 or Darkrai LV.X DP19. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Darkrai LV.X, DP Black Star Promo DP19. The English card: one of three LV.X tins released at the end of February 2008, each with four booster packs (one Great Encounters, one Mysterious Treasures and two Secret Wonders) and a holofoil LV.X: Darkrai LV.X here, Dialga LV.X DP17 or Palkia LV.X DP18. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Darkrai, DP Black Star Promo DP24. The English card: a holofoil Darkrai from the Darkrai Premium Box, released on 12 May 2008 with a Diamond & Pearl series theme deck, two booster packs and a jumbo copy of the card. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Tropical Wind, DP Black Star Promo DP25, the promo card of the 2008 Pokémon World Championships, which competitors received in seven languages, German among them. It has the Worlds 08 stamp on its picture.

description.text: The German print of Arceus, DP Black Star Promo DP50. The English card: a holofoil Arceus from two products released with the Arceus expansion on 4 November 2009. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Arceus LV.X, DP Black Star Promo DP53. The English card: a holofoil Arceus LV.X from the first, green Arceus Collector's Tin, planned for 2 December 2009 but brought forward to the Arceus expansion's release on 4 November. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.

The German print of Arceus LV.X, DP Black Star Promo DP56. The English card: a holofoil Arceus LV.X from the second, blue Arceus Collector's Tin, released on 16 December 2009 with two Arceus booster packs and two older Diamond & Pearl or Platinum series packs. Which German product held it isn't documented on any page found.
